experiments.name: Slime Humanoid Character
experiments.notes: ❌ Slime *man*, not a slime blob. Humanoid skeleton forced it into a bipedal shape. Looks like a green alien. The tool doesn't have a "blob" body type — only humanoid and quadruped.

experiments.name: Slime Map Object
experiments.notes: ✅ Actually looks like a slime blob! Amorphous ghost/blob shape, green, no limbs. Much better than the character tool for non-humanoid creatures. Single image though — no directional views.
